title: ‘खीर’ कथामा आयामिक लेखन {‘Kheer’ Dimensional Writing}
nepali: प्रस्तुत आुसन्धानमूलक लेख इन्द्रबहादुर राईको खीर कथाको विश्लेषणमा केन्द्रित छ । प्रस्तुत कथा राईको कथास्था कथा सब्ग्रहमा संकलित रहेको छ । खासगरी दार्जीलिब सेरोफेरोको निम्नवर्गीय नेपाली जीवनका संघर्ष र यथार्थलाई कथामा देखाउने आयामेली कथाकार राईको खीर कथालाई आयामेली साहित्यिक आन्दोलनका चिन्तन र मान्यताबाट यहाँ विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । नेपाली साहित्यमा देखिएका विभिन्न आन्दोलनमध्ये आयामेली आन्दोलन एक चर्चित र महत्वपूर्ण साहित्यिक आन्दोन हो । यही आयामेली आन्दोलनले स्थापित गरेको साहित्यिक मान्यता वा लेखनलाई आयामेली साहित्य वा लेखन भनिन्छ । आयामेली स्रष्टा राईको खीर कथामा आयामेली चिन्तन र लेखनको कसरी प्रयोग गरिएको छ ? भन्ने मूल प्रश्न वा समस्यामा केन्द्रित भई आयामेली साहित्यिक मान्यताका सापेक्षतामा खीर कथाको अध्ययन विश्लेषण यस लेखमा गरिएको छ । जीवनलाई सम्पूर्णतामा हेर्ने नवीन दृष्टिकोण आयामेली दृष्टिकोण हो । यसले जीवनको गहिराइ अर्थात् तेस्रो आयामलाई चिनाउने काम गरेको हुन्छ । खीर कथामा खीर प्रसङ्गबाट जीवन ज्यामीले पकाएको खीरजस्तै छ भन्ने निष्कर्ष आयामिक मान्यताका आधारमा निकालिएको छ । {The present research article focuses on the analysis of Indra Bahadur Rai's Kheer story. american_english: This research-based article focuses on the analysis of Indra Bahadur Rai's story "Kheer". This story is included in Rai's short story collection "Kathastha". In particular, Rai's "Kheer", a dimensional story that depicts the struggles and reality of lower-class Nepali life in and around Darjeeling, is analyzed here from the perspective of the thought and principles of the dimensional literary movement. Among the various movements seen in Nepali literature, the dimensional movement is a well-known and important literary movement. The literary beliefs or writing established by this dimensional movement are called dimensional literature or writing. Centering on the main question or problem of how dimensional thought and writing have been used in the story "Kheer" by the dimensional creator Rai, this article studies and analyzes the story "Kheer" in relation to dimensional literary principles. The dimensional perspective is a new way of looking at life in its entirety. It works to reveal the depth of life, that is, the third dimension. In the story "Kheer", on the basis of dimensional principles, the conclusion is drawn from the kheer episode that life is like the kheer cooked by a woman farmer.

translator_notes: The Nepali term 'आयामेली' (also appears as 'आयामिक') has been rendered consistently as 'dimensional' to reflect the Ayameli literary movement. 'ज्यामी' has been translated as 'woman farmer' to convey the intended meaning. 'दार्जीलिब सेरोफेरो' was interpreted as Darjeeling and its surrounding areas based on context.
